response.what_it_is: Rechargeable LED head torch in a plastic case
hidden_risks: Battery capacity and actual charge retention
Actual lumen output vs. claimed 125W specification
Whether the charging cable and accessories are included inside the case
response.best_proof: The photo of the product packaging showing the brand, model number, and specifications.
response.failure_mode: Confusing it with an automotive headlamp due to the word 'headlamp', or assuming it is used when it is clearly new shop stock in a protective case.
